one_line_description.value: Reducto is an agentic document platform whose API parses documents like a human would, capturing complex layouts, tables, and formatting with bounding-box citations.
one_line_description.quote: Reducto parse r-1 reads documents like a human would—capturing complex layouts, tables, and formatting with high accuracy and bounding-box citations.

api_breadth.value: REST, ~8 core sync endpoints (parse, extract, split, classify, edit, upload, job) plus async variants; read-write
api_breadth.quote: | Upload a local file | `/upload` | multipart `file` | | Run in the background | `/parse_async`, `/extract_async`, `/split_async`, `/classify_async`, `/edit_async` | `webhook` |

docs_url.quote: Create an API key in Reducto Studio (https://studio.reducto.ai) under API Keys.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Reducto ignores `scope`, `resource`, `audience` and `requested_token_type` if you send them.

access_model.quote: Sign up for a free account without leaving the docs. Sign up or sign in at https://studio.reducto.ai.

access_notes.value: Free self-serve Studio account with API key creation in Studio (no sales contact needed); paid Growth/Enterprise tiers gate higher page concurrency, SSO/SAML, HIPAA BAA, VPC/on-prem, and custom SLAs.
access_notes.quote: Sign up for a free account without leaving the docs. Sign up or sign in at https://studio.reducto.ai.

rate_limits.value: 1,000 req/s sustained for all endpoints; 300 req/s for GET /job/{job_id}; plus per-tier page concurrency caps (r-1 Standard: 500 US / 250 EU)
rate_limits.quote: | All endpoints | 1,000 req/s sustained | `{"message": "[CODE 1000] rate limit exceeded, retry with exponential backoff"}` | | `GET /job/{job_id}` | 300 req/s sustained |

sdk_languages.quote: The Python, Node.js, and Go SDKs read `REDUCTO_API_KEY` from the environment.

verdict_reason: Reducto publishes a full REST API reference with parse, extract, split, classify, edit, upload, async and job endpoints, plus Python, Node.js and Go SDKs and a hosted MCP server. Credentials are self-serve: the quickstart says to sign up for a free account at studio.reducto.ai and create an API key under API Keys. Documented rate limits and Svix/direct webhooks round out the integration surface; only enterprise capabilities require sales.
open_questions: No documented sandbox/test environment was found; only a free Studio account with sample documents is described, so sandbox_or_test_env is left not_found.
API versioning/deprecation/sunset policy was not present in the SOURCES text (the version-pinning and model-versions pages appeared in search results only), so versioning notes are not_found.
OAuth scope/permission model is not documented; the token-exchange reference states that scope, resource, audience and requested_token_type are ignored.
No community/third-party MCP servers appeared in the evidence; the uvx mcp-server-reducto package and hosted mcp.reducto.ai endpoint are vendor-operated.
Exact free-tier usage allowance (~$150) appears only in a pricing search snippet, not in the fetched SOURCES text, so it was not used as a claim.
